about.title: Colma Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Colma is a small place, with roughly 1,520 residents, and a loss here is felt by neighbors and not just relatives. In 2025, the town's final public-record count showed four injury collisions, five people hurt, and no traffic deaths, with reported crashes tending to cluster on Fridays near midday. Most of that activity sits along Hillside Boulevard, Junipero Serra Boulevard and El Camino Real (SR-82), the routes residents drive daily. Yet wrongful death claims for Colma families rarely stay inside town limits. A fatal crash on a nearby freeway, a workplace accident, a medical mistake at a Peninsula hospital, or a fall on poorly kept property can all lead to a claim. Under California law, the deceased person's spouse or domestic partner and children generally hold the first right to bring that claim, with certain dependents and heirs next in line. Families usually have two years from the date of death to file, and less time when a government agency is involved. The claim is civil and moves separately from any criminal charge, so it does not depend on a prosecutor's decision.

whyChoose.title: Why Colma Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who is allowed to file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney you're connected with can sort out where your family stands before anything is filed.

items.title: Attention to the two-year clock
items.desc: Families have two years from the date of death to bring a claim, and the window is shorter when a city, county or state agency is involved. Getting connected early helps protect that right.

items.title: A full picture of what can be recovered
items.desc: Beyond funeral and burial costs, the law recognizes lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. An independent attorney works on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: Our family member lived in Colma but died in a crash in another city. Can we still bring a claim?
items.answer: Yes. Where your loved one lived does not decide whether a claim exists; what matters is whether another party's negligence caused the death. Colma residents routinely travel Junipero Serra Boulevard, El Camino Real and nearby freeways, and a fatal collision anywhere in California can support a wrongful death action. The attorney can determine which county court is the proper place to file.

items.question: Does a wrongful death case wait for the criminal case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that runs on its own track, separate from any criminal charges the district attorney may pursue. The two cases have different goals and different standards of proof. A civil claim can move forward even if no criminal case is ever filed.

items.question: What does it cost to use LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and there is no charge for being matched with an independent attorney. The attorneys in our network handle wrongful death claims on contingency, so you owe no fee unless there is a recovery.
